rationale: The strongest local family is still the compact reverse-tail recurrent baseline, but its recurrence curriculum was keyed to nominal iteration count even though the launcher is wallclock-capped. On a 600 second Mac-mini run that can leave the staged tail recurrence under-activated or inconsistently activated across throughput regimes. This edit keeps the same architecture and export path, but re-times the tail recurrence schedule against usable training wallclock before the reserved final-eval window, so the recurrent tail ramps when the run is actually late rather than when an arbitrary ITERATIONS counter says it is late.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Reverse-Tail Recurrence Curriculum
